thread:
nina (People Ops): Heads-up — we're doing a surprise 'Thank You' kit drop for folks who've received spot awards this quarter. Need help with logistics + approvals. Goal: ship next Wed-Thu window.

cj (Eng): Love it. What goes in the kit?

marta (Design): thinking: enamel pin, handwritten note, snack, sticker sheet, and a small plant/seed packet. low footprint.

jack (Finance): Budget per kit? Need cost estimate before sign-off.

nina (People Ops): Targeting ~$22–28 per kit incl shipping. Can we cap at $30 to be safe. Will send vendor quote.

alex (Ops): I can run a quick cost calc + preferred shipping carriers. Also volunteer to coordinate packing next Tue.

nina (People Ops): Awesome — could you export current list of spot-award recipients and addresses? I have a Google Form but need a CSV from HR payroll for verified addresses.

cj (Eng): cc @people-bot — can you pull the last 90 days of spot-award recipients and verify manager approvals?

people-bot: Fetching: found 34 spot awards in last 90 days. 31 have manager approvals, 3 missing manager sign-off. See export link: https://go.example.com/spot-awards-export (CSV)

nina (People Ops): Thanks. For the 3 missing approvals, can managers confirm by end of day Monday? We don't want to ship without approval. deadline = `2026-04-06 17:00 PT`.

marta (Design): Drafted note templates — short + personalizable. Posting in #people-ops-assets in a minute.

alex (Ops): Shipping notes — do we have international addresses? Customs forms could add time/cost.

people-bot: Export shows 5 international addresses (EU x3, UK x1, CA x1). Estimated customs + shipping add-on ~$8/intl unit.

jack (Finance): Ok factor that into budget. If 5 intl at +$8 = extra $40 total. Still within runway. Approving up to $1,200 for this program.

cj (Eng): Volunteer list for hand-assembling? I can bring tape + labels.

nina (People Ops): Need 4 volunteers for Tue afternoon (2–5pm). @alex volunteers. @marta can you do a morning QA on sticker sheets?

marta (Design): Yep morning QA works. I'll also finalize the envelope art.

alex (Ops): I'll build packing spreadsheet. Requesting fields: Name | Shipping addr | Kit variant (intl/dom) | Note text | Manager | Tracking number | Packed by | Shipped date. I'll share a template.

nina (People Ops): Perfect. For privacy, only Ops and People Ops will see full addresses. We'll share a packing view with masked addresses for volunteers (city + last 4 digits).

cj (Eng): Quick Q: are contractors eligible? We have 4 contractors in export. Policy?

nina (People Ops): Good catch. Policy: spot awards apply to active payroll employees and contractors on contract >90 days unless flagged. People Ops will review the 4 contractors and confirm eligibility by EOD Monday.

jack (Finance): Also confirm tax treatment for contractors vs employees. I can loop in payroll team if needed.

nina (People Ops): Action items: 1) @people-bot export done (thanks). 2) Managers of 3 missing approvals confirm by `2026-04-06 17:00 PT`. 3) People Ops to vet 4 contractors. 4) Alex to share packing sheet + volunteer shifts by Monday AM. 5) Marta finalize assets today. 6) Jack approves up to $1,200.

people-bot: Reminder set: managers_missing_approvals -> `2026-04-06T17:00:00-07:00`

cj (Eng): Sign me up for packing Tue 2–5.

marta (Design): I can do QA Tue 9–11 and help pack Tue 11–1 if needed.

alex (Ops): I'll post the packing spreadsheet here by Monday 9am and add a column for volunteers to sign up.

nina (People Ops): Thank you all. If managers want personalized notes, drop drafts into the sheet under "Note text" by Tuesday 9am. Otherwise we'll use the templated notes.

cj (Eng): One last thing — do we announce publicly or keep it surprise?

nina (People Ops): Plan is surprise drop + public shoutout in #general the next week with photos (opt-in). We'll ask recipients if they'd like a public shoutout.

jack (Finance): Sounds good. Keep receipts and upload to expense tracker with code `PEOPLE-RECOG-Q2`.

people-bot: Confirmed. Calendar event created: "Thanks Kit Packing — People Ops" Tue 2026-04-07 14:00 PT.

nina (People Ops): Closing thread — I'll post final packing list Monday AM. Thanks everyone! :heart:
